description: CV expander for EqMaster, placed on either side of it, with polyphonic CV over the band controls and the active state of all 24 tracks

inputs.text: Sixteen channels of CV for that track's EQ, four channels per band running from low to high, each band taking active, then frequency, then gain, then Q
Switches the EQ of tracks 1 to 16 in and out, one track per channel
Switches the EQ of the four groups in and out on channels 1 to 4 and the four auxes on channels 5 to 8, with the global bypass on channel 9

notes: the expander does nothing on its own: it must be placed immediately beside an EqMaster, on either side of it, and the jacks then drive that EqMaster.
